test_title: PYST 67: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Transnational linkages, for example, sever the nation-state's __integrity and corrupt__ state-society relations.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. cohesion and erode.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Cohesion" **refers to the action or fact of forming a united whole. (संबद्धता)

 
 
• **Example:** The cohesion among the team members was evident in their smooth coordination during the project.
 
 
 
• The word **"erode"** means to gradually wear away or be worn away by natural agents. (क्षरण करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The coastline has been eroded by the sea.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **cohesion and erode**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Divergence** (विचलन): The process or state of diverging.

 
 
• **Example:** There was a clear divergence between the two opinions.
 
 
 
• **Relativity** (सापेक्षता): The absence of standards of absolute and universal application.
 
 
• **Example:** The theory of relativity revolutionized physics.
 
 
 
• **Severance** (विच्छेद): The action of ending a connection or relationship.
 
 
• **Example:** The severance of diplomatic ties was a significant event.
 
 
 
• **Revolution** (क्रांति): A forcible overthrow of a government or social order, in favor of a new system.
 
 
• **Example:** The Industrial Revolution brought great changes to society.
 
 
 
• **Controversy** (विवाद): Disagreement, typically when prolonged, public, and heated.
 
 
• **Example:** The new policy caused a lot of controversy.
 
 
 
• **Diminution** (कमी): A reduction in the size, extent, or importance of something.
 
 
• **Example:** There has been a diminution in the number of students attending the school.
 
 

3c:Tc30,
The correct answer is Option 2</stro
